messages.content: Use web search to find relevant datasets. Only include landing pages or DOIs. Do not invent links. Do not call time, date, timestamp, or clock tools.

Query: Can you find datasets about digitalization, telecommuting, workaholism, and job performance in Germany during the 2010s, matching this research need: survey data on employees in Germany, 2017–2018, examining homeoffice or remote work and work addiction, including frequency of working from home, formal agreements, and ability to count homeoffice hours
Respond ONLY as JSON in this exact shape: {"items":[{"title":"...","url_or_doi":"...","justification":"..."}]}. Put any DOI, URL, landing page, or link in url_or_doi.
